passages.note: Wiener is the named author of SB 770 and appears among the Ayes on its final concurrence vote.

passages.provision_quote: the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system, to provide accessible, affordable, equitable, and high-quality health care for all Californians.
passages.note: The bill's operative sections only direct a waiver-framework study, stakeholder engagement, and reports; its findings state the goal of unified single-payer-style financing (H16).

rows.reasoning: SB 770, which Wiener authored and voted for, orders the Secretary to research and pursue a waiver framework with the objective of a unified-financing system and states in its findings that 'the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system'; but its operative sections (1001-1002) only require research, stakeholder engagement, and reports, enacting no coverage or financing system. Per the study-directive rule, a bill that states its goal but takes no present action can show only direction toward 'Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector,' not that rung itself.
needs_source: An enacted or voted single-payer/public-option coverage bill with an operative coverage or financing mandate (not a study/waiver-framework directive) to establish a numeric chair
